name: Double Torch Strike
body:
Striking the target with your torch multiple times, you can inflict terrible burns.

Prerequisite(s): Pyro torch attack class feature, Dex 17, Torch Weapon Mastery base attack bonus +8.

Benefit(s): If you hit an opponent with your melee torch attack at least twice in the same round, you deal an additional 2d6 points of fire damage (or cold damage for witchlight torches). You can only deal this additional damage once each round.
